plain: Claiming a power or right that is not yours.

webster.text: The act of arrogating, or making exorbitant claims; the act of taking more than one is justly entitled to.

example.quote: I hope that my countrymen will keep guard against every arrogation of power.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
